public_rationale: Under the post's contextual meaning—private Office documents being taken for generative AI training—the contemporaneous record contradicts the allegation. Microsoft explicitly denied using Microsoft 365 customer data to train large language models and denied that the connected-services setting enabled such training. Connected features can analyze document contents, but that is a different activity. The finding depends on reading scraping in its training context.
limitations: The decisive evidence is Microsoft's statement reported by a news outlet, not an independent dataset audit.
The conclusion concerns the contextual generative-AI allegation, not all document processing or all machine-learning uses.
Marcus expressed uncertainty rather than categorical certainty.
